svg.text: Head silhouette + body air · direction proof v4
REVIEW ONLY · lower-face anchors first · static y−5 cell reframe · hair and body remain independent parts
round · broad · long · block · point · lantern
no bones · no pose IDs · west still mirrored
reframed body plans touch an edge
proof uses a static five-unit crop shift; high hair audits separately
A · same body, same air: current head family vs. stronger lower-face anchors
Portrait gives the design read; literal 40 px south/east silhouettes decide whether it survives gameplay.
Round/Oval and Boxy/Soft-square remain the collapse risks.
Crown held near the hair datum; jaw and chin do the separating.
B · separation ladder: choose raster air, not an abstract anchor offset
Same Round head + Block body. Outline-to-outline space is measured from the final transparent 40 px render.
C · one static system: six heads paired with the accepted six body envelopes
Each body owns one south/north and one east/west head datum; every head reuses it. Neutral close-hanging arms remain present.
Direction read: one 40 px row makes the head feel deliberately mounted; a static crop reframe keeps it in-cell without articulated anatomy.
